assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period.
The diagnosis codes I49.9, I48.91, and R55 are associated with the patient's condition.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is provided under CPT code 93229.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The provider has the right to appeal this determination.
A formal appeal must be submitted within the timeframe specified in the provider agreement.
Supporting clinical documentation that justifies the medical necessity of the service should be included with the appeal.
Failure to adhere to these requirements may result in the finalization of this denial.
